name: SolveLevels
comment: Returns fall, upstream level, and downstream level as a 1×3 row. Arguments: length, fall, upstreamLevel, downstreamLevel. length is in metres. fall is the run in 1:fall, and the level difference is length/fall. Supply any two of fall, upstreamLevel, and downstreamLevel. An omitted, blank, 0, or "-" fall counts as missing. An omitted, blank, or "-" level counts as missing. A level of 0 is used. Equal levels return "-" for the fall. Any other count returns "Please Input 2 out of 3 Items". Text returns #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
